verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes custom event capture via SDKs, HTTP-based event capture, and session replay/DevTools panels, but never mentions PostHog's autocapture-style feature for automatically capturing clicks, pageviews, and form interactions without instrumentation code. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of autocapture configuration/toggle, evidence that pageviews/clicks/form submits are captured by default, and any hands-on confirmation that no per-event code is required.
